lines:
flowchart TD
A["Token holds explicit context revision R0"] --> B{"Frozen control construct"}
B -- "Normal node" --> C["Apply typed patch atomically to R0"]
C --> D["Create revision R1 with provenance"]
D --> Z["Advance only on a frozen transition"]
B -- "Router selects one path" --> E["Record classification, considered routes, matched rule, tier, and destination"]
E --> F["Revise R0 and move token to selected existing edge"]
F --> Z
B -- "Router selects many, Parallel, or For Each" --> G["Create branch frame from R0 with stable child IDs or item indexes"]
G --> H["Fork isolated revisions R0.1 through R0.n"]
H --> I["Admit bounded child work from hierarchical budget"]
I --> J["Each branch revises only its own lineage"]
J --> K{"Frozen join completion rule satisfied"}
K -- "No" --> L["Record failure, cancellation, skipped path, or wait for declared arrivals"]
L --> K
K -- "Yes" --> M["Order arrivals by frozen branch ordinal or item index"]
M --> N["Apply declared map, aggregate, evaluator, or conflict policy"]
N --> O{"Reconciliation valid"}
O -- "No" --> P["Emit explicit JoinBlocked or follow declared failure edge"]
O -- "Yes" --> Q["Create joined revision RJ with all parent revision IDs"]
Q --> Z
B -- "Visible bounded loop" --> R["Evaluate frozen exit condition at loop header"]
R --> S{"Exit condition true"}
S -- "Yes" --> Z
S -- "No" --> T{"Iteration, nesting, deadline, and budget permit another pass"}
T -- "No" --> U["Emit LimitExceeded and use declared failure or fallback edge"]
T -- "Yes" --> V["Record next loop frame and follow the visible frozen feedback edge"]
V --> W["Node work creates a new immutable revision"]
W --> R
AA["No shared mutable context"] --> H
AB["No arrival-order or last-writer-wins merge"] --> M
AC["Retries and child branches consume ancestor budgets"] --> I

data.title: Context Revision, Fork, Join, and Visible Loop Semantics
